behavior.ordinaryRpcOutage: Previously finalized works remain Minted with one page-level Warning; immutable revealed artwork is retained.
behavior.unfinalizedOutage: Previously revealed artwork is retained with an unavailable/rechecking status; no unsupported finalization.
behavior.incrementalObserver: Bootstrap the deployment history once per process, privately checkpoint the verified finalized prefix, and rebuild the entire unfinalized suffix on each subsequent pass.
behavior.checkpointGuards: Both endpoints recheck the old finalized anchor and shared heads; source disagreement, regressed finality, forged checkpoints and out-of-range logs cannot publish partial snapshots.
behavior.finalityConflict: A contradicted finalized anchor or covered finalized receipt invalidates the qualified status and blocks mint admission; ordinary later transport failures cannot clear that dispute.
behavior.reorg: A newer canonical scan can withdraw unfinalized receipt hints; it cannot silently erase or replace finalized evidence.
behavior.mintAdmission: Still requires a healthy snapshot no older than 90 seconds, current wallet proof, explicit spending consent and the durable begin fence.
behavior.rpcScheduling: At most two physical requests in flight per endpoint, one-second start spacing, and one safe-read retry with three-second backoff on rate limits; broadcasts are never retried.
behavior.health: Safe scan bounds, refresh duration, source/method identifiers and numeric failure codes only; no RPC credential or signed data.
